caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted mechanical device consisting of several parts: a rectangular, textured brown wooden board forms the background, with a metallic, trapezoidal funnel on the upper portion attached to its surface. This funnel has a lid that is open, revealing its empty interior. Below the funnel, a circular grinding mechanism is visible, predominantly gray in color with metallic hues and flanked by two symmetrical, dark-colored side fixtures that anchor it to the board. Extending from the center of this mechanism is a curved, metallic crank handle, ending with a cylindrical, wood-textured grip. The handle is oriented downward and to the right. The drawing is composed primarily of shades of brown, gray, and metallic silver, rendered with detailed, fine lines and shading on a plain, off-white background.
title: Coffee Mill
